info.title: ERPLY Books Universal API
info.description: ERPLY Books lets you connect your ERPLY account to list retail master data, customers, company settings, sales documents, inventory references, and supporting accounting records through the classic ERPLY API.

get.description: Authenticates an ERPLY Books connection and returns session details.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
